sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: easy to use as a whole food. Simple, recognisable, and realistic for everyday eating. One of the clearest antioxidant-identity fruits. Blueberries have a stronger cultural and practical antioxidant case than a generic fruit baseline. Hydrating whole-fruit package. Water and whole-food structure make it easier to use well than juice or sweets.
